final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT pa.player_id AS pid, p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS c FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), s2 AS (SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS c FROM s1 GROUP BY bats), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.bats AS bats, s2.c AS c, s2.c * 1.0 / s3.t AS r FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.t IS NOT NULL), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s4) SELECT s4.bats, s4.c, s4.r, s4.r - s5.a FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s4.r > s5.a
